global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible oil sheen. Topped with minced pork, chopped green onions, and a whole boiled egg, it sits in a white bowl against a dark wooden surface under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised rim, showing faint orange residue along its inner edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and minced meat, has rich orange hue and glossy surface.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, smooth white surface with subtle sheen, oval shape, slightly translucent at edges.
